headline: Avoiding Common Room Painting Blunders
articleBody: Painting a single room can seem straightforward, but it's easy to make a few common mistakes that can impact the final look and durability. One of the biggest blunders is choosing a paint color from a tiny chip without testing it in the actual room. Colors can look drastically different under various lighting conditions and next to your existing furniture and decor. Always test samples on your walls first! Another frequent oversight is underestimating the amount of prep work needed. Skipping steps like cleaning, patching holes, and repairing cracks means the paint won't adhere properly, leading to a less-than-perfect finish or even peeling down the line. Failing to define the full scope—do you want the trim, ceiling, or inside the closet painted too?—can lead to misunderstandings or an incomplete look. Lastly, not adequately protecting floors and furniture can result in messy and costly cleanups. Taking the time to properly prepare, test colors, and clearly define the project scope, or better yet, entrusting it to a professional like Frasheski Construction, can help you achieve a beautiful and lasting result.
